A screen's surface is phone (the iPhone and Android), watch (the Apple Watch and Wear OS) or desktop (QuestPump on the computer, macOS and Windows, and since slice 63 the browser's QuestPump at play.questpump.com, platform web, which shows the desktop app's pages; a screen of the computer's alone names macos and windows in `platforms`, with the reason in `only`); an entry on more than one surface lists them in `surfaces` instead (a kit component the phones and the desktop app both draw), never both fields. A desktop screen the system draws from words Rust hands it (the tray's menu, the window's frame and the macOS app menu) is `native`. tools/copytext.py reads the list: each key of contract/copy/en.json names the screens that show it and ships on their apps (on the desktop and the web through helper/dist/lib/copy.js, and a native screen's keys through helper/src-tauri/src/copy.rs too), and `make check` (copytext.py --check) fails on an id or a name listed twice, a surface other than phone, watch or desktop, both or neither of `surface` and `surfaces`, `platforms` naming an app outside its surfaces, or `native` off a desktop screen.
